## 441. The other 87 schema-1 records, migrated: every record on schema 2 (DF3, batch B)

Board item DF, under RA. Batch A (§436) migrated the thirty schema-1 records DF1 named. Batch B migrates the other 87, on main at `5acc60130` and merged with main before landing, so every result record is now on schema 2. It follows batch A's method ([plan](../../../../2026-10-05-repository-reconciliation/architecture/df/DF3-PLAN.md)). The brief added what batch A's reviews and cold read had caught:
- each law names its own hypotheses;
- a negated universal is not written as an existential;
- a counterexample must be a case some declaration witnesses;
- evidence paragraphs name each receipt's checker, Lean version and axiom reports;
- readings keep their AI label, and Ren's words are kept as provenance only.

The work is the AI's ([kit](../../../../2026-10-05-repository-reconciliation/architecture/df/README.md)).

